subject: Re: Quick 20m walkthrough — usage threshold
messages:
From: Aisha Kapoor <aisha@searchly.ai>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 20 Nov 2027 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Usage spike — interested in a quick walkthrough

Hey Jonas,

We just crossed the 100k-token threshold on our self-serve project this morning and saw a noticeable latency variance across recent runs. I kicked off a quick audit but wanted to flag it with someone from Redwood since we're evaluating dedicated capacity next quarter.

Would you have 20 minutes next week for a short walkthrough of best practices (batching, KV cache setup, quantization tradeoffs) and an estimate on expected cost delta if we move to a small Dedicated pool?

A few quick details so you have context:
- Org: Searchly (growth@searchly.ai)
- Current pattern: many short prompts (avg 40 tokens) with occasional long-run summaries (2–4k tokens)
- Trial tokens used: ~130k this week

I've attached a small CSV with anonymized sample runs. Happy to invite our infra lead if that helps.

Thanks,
Aisha Kapoor
Product Growth, Searchly
[Attachment: usage-report-Searchly-20271120.csv (csv)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Kapoor <aisha@searchly.ai>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 21 Nov 2027 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Usage spike — interested in a quick walkthrough

Hi Aisha — thanks for the data and the heads up.

Short answer: yes — we can cover batching/kv-cache suggestions and a Dedicated sizing estimate in 20 minutes. I looked at your CSV and it shows a mix we typically optimize with a small Dedicated pool + prefix caching.

Are any of these slots doable?
- Tue 23 Nov: 10:00–10:20 PT
- Tue 23 Nov: 14:30–14:50 PT
- Wed 24 Nov: 08:30–08:50 PT

Or grab my calendar here: https://calendly.com/jonas-weber/20min — pick a time and I’ll send a calendar invite.

I’m cc’ing Marissa from Solutions Engineering so we can cover cost estimates; I’ll loop in Soojin (ops) if you want a deeper infra walkthrough.

Attachment: I also attached a short 1-page proposal that covers common Dedicated sizing profiles — early read might help the call.

Cheers,
Jonas Weber
SDR — Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai
[Attachment: proposal-redwood-20m.pdf (pdf)]

Thanks Jonas — appreciate the quick reply.

The 10:00 PT slot on Tue 23 won't work — we've got a product all-hands. 14:30 PT is better but our infra lead (Ravi, ravi@searchly.ai) is only available 15:00–17:00 PT that day. Could we do a quick swap to 15:10 PT on Tue, or alternatively Wed 08:30 PT works for the broader team.

If you do 15:10 we can have Ravi on to confirm cost assumptions. Also, could you add a brief agenda and the one-pager to the invite so Ravi knows what to expect?

Please loop in Soojin if you think we'll need kernel-level tuning discussion.

Thanks — Aisha
